_comment: An identity provider estate that is mostly automated and not entirely, which is what a real
one looks like and what makes the check worth running.
The two failures are the ones the indicator exists to find, and neither is visible from the
cloud side. break-glass@ was created at a console: its permissions may be perfect, but it
exists because a person made it, so nothing removes it when that person forgets. And
Platform Admins is a privileged group with hand-curated membership — access added by hand is
removed by hand, which is the leaver problem in one line.
svc-deploy@ is DEPROVISIONED and therefore not-applicable rather than passing: counting dead
accounts as evidence of automation would let an estate improve its score by accumulating them.
No hr_source is declared, so the bundle carries a reconciliation note saying that an account
provisioned correctly by automation and belonging to somebody who left in March is invisible
here. That is the half an IdP cannot answer on its own.
